_comment: Read a steady EXTERNAL DC voltage (or slow signal) on CH1 over a LONG window, transferring the WHOLE record. MANual timebase (horizontal_mode) so record_length + sample_rate are AUTHORITATIVE - the acquired record equals what you capture, instead of the scope auto-managing a huge record and the read pulling only a sliver. record_length 10000 at 500 S/s = a 20 s window (10000 / 500); the level is taken as the mean over that record. DC coupling is essential (AC would strip the level away). AUTO trigger (a flat line has no edge). CH1 5 V/div covers ~+/-20 V (automotive, e.g. 14 V), 1 MOhm. For other windows at 10000 pts change sample_rate: 250 -> 40 s, 500 -> 20 s, 1000 -> 10 s, 100 -> 100 s. Use: configure_scope(alias, 'dc_read', '1') then capture_scope(alias, '1'); do NOT also pass duration_s (MANual derives s/div from record_length + sample_rate). Verify with get_scope_config_report - the scope quantizes sample_rate to nearest, record_length stays 10000 so the full window transfers. NOTE: configs are read once at import - reload configs / restart the process after editing this file.
name: dc_read
